messages:
maya: Heads up — new reranker (ranky-3b-ptq) on quant sweep flipped NDCG@10 for short queries after we enabled priming. See quick numbers below.

cheng: WTF — flipped how? can you paste the eval command and a tiny summary?

maya: Run: `./eval_runner --model ranky-3b-ptq --priming nudge --seq-len 128 --batch 64 --holdout holdout-v2`

maya: Topline: NDCG@10 dropped for short queries (<=10 tokens). For long queries (>50) it's fine. MRR roughly stable.

sam: Do you mean priming as in prepending candidate titles vs model priming via system tokens? We added the 'nudge' tokenized prompt last week.

maya: It's the tokenized priming (we prepend `NUDGE:` + user query). I suspected warmstart cache interaction with prefix KV caching.

eval-bot: eval-run 5123 finished: ndcg@10_short=0.672 -> 0.619 (-0.053), ndcg@10_long=0.734 -> 0.729 (-0.005), mrr_short=0.485 -> 0.477

cheng: That's nontrivial. Did you rerun with KV cache disabled and single-request mode?

maya: Yes. With `--kv-cache=false --batch=1` ndcg@10_short=0.671 (basically restored). So seems batching + priming + quantized kernels => interaction.

sam: :thinking_face: Could be rounding/accumulation with int8 matmul + different attention kernels for batch>1. Also check tokenizer differences — maybe `NUDGE:` token splits weirdly.

maya: Checked tokenization parity — same. I nuked priming text to `>>` minimal priming and saw ndcg_short=0.668 (better). So priming length matters.

cheng: Plan: 1) sweep priming length (none, short token, medium token, long token) 2) run with/without batching and kv-cache 3) compare fp32 baseline. Sam take 1+3, Maya take 2.

sam: On it. Quick note: re-run fp32 baseline with same priming will show if quantization amplifies the effect.

ops-bot: Deploy alert: dedicated pool 'ranky-3b-ptq' currently serving canary traffic. Re-route if needed: `/ops reroute ranky-3b-ptq -> fallback-ranky-3b-fp32`

maya: Thanks. We'll triage before reroute but will failover if impact > ~4% ndcg@10 across core queries.

cheng: Also make a diagnostic eval set (priming-short-200) focused on head intents; run paired t-test to check significance. Use seed=42 and attach topk outputs.

maya: I already spun up diag set `priming-short-200` and pushed to eval-runner. eval id 5123-priming-short (results above).

sam: I'll attach a PR with logs + minimal reproducer. Expect preliminary results by EOD :clock3:.

maya: :thumbsup: If this holds, mitigation options: trim priming length for quant variants, force batch=1 for short queries, or selectively disable KV caching for canary.
